Starting Monday, October 6, the Blue Line subway will [1] every six minutes during rush hour, compared with the current ten-minute interval. [2] The change follows a rise in the number of daily passengers over the past two years. Monthly passes will remain [3] at $75, but a new discounted pass for students will be available. Riders can buy tickets at stations or [4] the Transit City mobile app.

questions.explanation: Trains 'run' at a certain frequency.

choices: Additional trains have been purchased to make this possible.
The mayor will open a new park.
Bus fares will be reviewed next spring.
The airport has a new terminal.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains how the higher frequency is possible, before the reason for the change.
'Remain unchanged' means that the price stays the same.
'Through the app' expresses the means of buying.

Dear Ms. Jordan,

[2] Production normally takes two weeks, [3] we can deliver sooner if your order is urgent. I have attached our current catalog and price list for your [4]. Please let me know if you would like a sample.

questions.explanation: 'Or more' is the fixed expression for a minimum quantity.

choices: The factory will close for the holidays.
Our sales team has moved to the fourth floor.
All of our notebooks are made from 100 percent recycled paper.
questions.explanation: The sentence supports the product's description before production time is discussed.
The faster delivery contrasts with the usual two weeks.
'For your reference' is a fixed expression.

text:
Marathon Draws Record Crowd

More than 12,000 runners took part in Sunday's City Marathon, the largest turnout in the event's history. [1] The course, which winds through the downtown area and along the river, was lined with cheering spectators. Organizers said they [2] additional water stations this year, which helped runners cope with the warm weather. The winner, Kenyan athlete Peter Mwangi, finished the race in two hours and eight minutes, [3] a new course record. Next year's marathon is scheduled to be held [4] April 20.

choices: The city's population has grown by six percent.
Tickets for the concert sold out quickly.
The weather forecast predicts rain on Monday.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives more detail about the participants before the course is described.
The simple past is needed to report a past action.
A present participle expresses the result of finishing so fast.
'On' is used with a specific date.

text:
MEMO
To: All residents
From: Building Management
Subject: Water heater replacement

The building's old water heaters will be replaced next week. [1] Residents will have no hot water between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday. We [2] you to plan accordingly. For those who wish to shower elsewhere, free passes to the nearby fitness center are [3] at the management office. Thank you for your understanding as we work to [4] the building's facilities.

choices: The elevators are inspected every year.
The work is necessary to improve energy efficiency and reduce monthly costs.
The lobby will be repainted in blue.
Rent is due on the first of the month.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives the reason for the replacement, before the consequences are explained.
'Advise' is the verb used with an object and 'to + verb'.
An adjective is needed after 'are'.
One 'improves' facilities, meaning one makes them better.

text: Meet the Nova X2, the smartphone built for busy professionals. Its battery lasts up to two days on a single charge, [1] its fast-charging feature restores 80 percent in just thirty minutes. [2] The 12-megapixel camera captures clear photos even in low light. The Nova X2 is [3] in black, silver, and blue. Buy one before November 30 and [4] a free protective case worth $30.

questions.explanation: The two advantages are added to each other.

choices: Its large display makes reading and watching videos a pleasure.
Smartphones should not be used while driving.
Our stores are closed on Sundays.
The company has existed for twenty years.
questions.explanation: The sentence presents another feature of the phone, before the camera is described.
The passive 'is offered in' lists the available colors.
The base form is needed after 'and' in an imperative sentence.

text:
Dear Parents and Guardians,

The annual Science Fair at Parkview Elementary will be held on Friday, March 14, in the school gymnasium. [1] Students in grades 3 to 6 have been working on their projects for the past six weeks. Visitors are welcome from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. [2] there will be a short awards ceremony at 3:15 p.m. We [3] parents to help by bringing refreshments or volunteering to supervise. If you [4] interested, please contact Ms. Reyes at the school office.

choices: The school bus will be replaced in June.
This year's theme is renewable energy.
Report cards will be sent next week.
The cafeteria offers a vegetarian menu.
questions.explanation: The sentence introduces the event, and the next sentence gives information about the projects.
'Afterward' places the ceremony after the visiting hours.
The plural subject 'We' takes the base form.
'You' takes 'are' in the present tense.

text:
Cancellation Policy

Registrations may be canceled free of charge up to fourteen days before the start of the workshop. [1] Cancellations made within fourteen days will be subject to a fee of 50 percent. No refunds are [2] for no-shows. If you are unable to attend, you may [3] your place to a colleague, [4] you notify us in writing at least two days in advance.

choices: The workshop will take place in Chicago.
A full refund will be issued within ten business days.
Lunch is provided for all participants.

questions.explanation: The sentence continues the free-cancellation rule, which contrasts with the next one.
The passive 'are issued' is needed.
One 'transfers' a place to someone else.
'Provided (that)' introduces a condition.

text:
Dear team,

I am writing to inform you that our quarterly sales meeting has been [1] from Friday to Monday at 10 a.m. [2] This change is due to the unexpected absence of our regional director, who will be traveling on Friday. Please [3] your calendars accordingly and notify me [4] you have a conflict. Thank you for your flexibility.

questions.explanation: The passive 'has been moved' is needed.

choices: The sales figures were released on Friday.
The conference room will be painted next week.

questions.explanation: The sentence gives information about the meeting after the date change.
After 'Please', the base form is used.
The notice is requested only in the case of a conflict.
